products.name: Azure Virtual Desktop — Deployment, Golden Image & FSLogix — Commercial
products.short_description: Stand up Azure Virtual Desktop the right way — host pools, a golden image, FSLogix profiles, and autoscale that controls cost.
products.description:
Stand up Azure Virtual Desktop the right way — host pools, a golden image, FSLogix profiles, and autoscale that controls cost.

Deploying AVD by hand produces snowflake session hosts, roaming-profile pain, and a runaway bill. This solution builds AVD properly: host pools and workspaces, a versioned golden image (with an image-build pipeline), FSLogix profile containers on Azure Files/NetApp, app groups and RBAC, and scaling plans that shut idle hosts down.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Host pools, workspaces, and application groups with RBAC
  • Golden image build + versioning (Azure Compute Gallery / image pipeline)
  • FSLogix profile containers on Azure Files or NetApp Files
  • Session-host deployment (Bicep/Terraform) and drain/patch workflow
  • Autoscale scaling plans and cost controls

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A repeatable, cost-controlled AVD estate with consistent golden images and roaming profiles — not hand-built snowflake hosts.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AVDDEP-Discovery.ps1 — Inventory the AVD build estate: Compute Gallery images, host pools, session hosts, FSLogix storage, and scaling plans
    • AVDDEP-Maintenance.ps1 — Safe drain-and-patch workflow: preview (default) or apply drain mode on session hosts ahead of an image-version replacement
    • AVDDEP-Report.ps1 — Produce an inventory/cost-posture report of the AVD deployment estate (images, hosts, drain status, scaling schedules, VM sizing)
    • AVDDEP-Validate.ps1 — Validate the built AVD estate against the deployment gates (image provenance, host health, FSLogix, RBAC, scaling)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
